return $('Config').all().map(it => ({ json: { body: {
  filterGroups: [{ filters: [
    { propertyName: 'hs_meeting_start_time', operator: 'GTE', value: String(it.json.fromMs) },
    { propertyName: 'hs_meeting_start_time', operator: 'LT', value: String(it.json.toMs) }]}],
  properties: ['hs_meeting_title','hs_activity_type','hs_meeting_outcome','hs_createdate',
    'hs_meeting_start_time','hubspot_owner_id','hs_attendee_owner_ids','hs_internal_meeting_notes','hs_meeting_body'],
  sorts: [{ propertyName: 'hs_object_id', direction: 'ASCENDING' }], limit: 200 } } }));
